title: FBI Attributes $6.3B Binance Heist to North Korea
excerpt: The FBI confirms North Korean hackers orchestrated a massive $6.3 billion cryptocurrency theft from Binance, setting a new record.
body_html:
The FBI has officially verified that a group of state-sponsored hackers from North Korea, identified as TraderTraitor, executed a massive cryptocurrency theft targeting Binance. The cyberattack resulted in the loss of $6.3 billion.

According to the confirmation, this incident stands as the largest cryptocurrency heist recorded to date. Authorities continue to monitor and investigate the activities associated with the breach.
